faction lowered: None [ edit ] Description Elrena says, "The events of the cataclysm taint the swamp even to this day." "When the great deluge of Zoth Uluus poured crashing onto this forest, Zoth's foul tendrils sank into the loamy soils. Those beings who were not drowned became infused with his blight." "The treants , once great protectors of this place, now walk with black, waterlogged roots, angry and mindless. They have become blight striders. There is naught to do but journey to the Tree of Corruption and destroy them." [ edit ] Objectives Travel to the Tree of Corruption to the northeast and slay the blight striders there. faction lowered: Order of the True Blood [ edit ] Description Lennea says, " Queen Ilyia has wisely chosen to forbid her citizens from speaking of the drake riders , but because we are sworn to destroy them, we must discuss them somewhat." "We aren't certain when the drake riders first took over Thelaseen , or even what their ultimate goals are. Regardless, rather than murder fellow elves , focus on slaying the breeding drakes ." "Without drakes , the Order of the True Blood becomes a manageable threat. We'll be able to deal with them if they make a move against us." faction lowered: None [ edit ] Description Silan says, "Since I do not care to venture back to Leth Nurae to purchase from my usual supplier, I would appreciate it if you would procure me some frog skin plasma." "The liquid aspect of frog skin serves as an important emulsifier for a few arcane potions." "Your process is quite simple. Kill a frog , skin it, and crush the skin to extract the plasma. Mind you, only the dendrobian frogs to the south will yield the correct skins. Not every frog will have a good skin, either." [ edit ] Objectives Collect frog skin from dendrobian frogs found to the south of the Wardship. Crush the frog skin to produce frog skin plasma. Return with the plasma to Silan Maenian at the Wardship of the Sleeping Moon . Frog Skin Plasma (14) [ edit ] Upon Completion You will be given the following rewards: ? Celestine Ward faction A coin reward of 7s 50c A choice from: Veil of Vitality Veil of Resitance Veil of Insight Veil of Might Retrieved from " http://wiki.silkyvenom.com/index.php/Frogs%2C_Freshly_Squeezed " Category : Thestra 31-35 Quests

"I will give you a specially calibrated device. If it reaches temperatures above a certain point, it will change color permanently from blue to red. faction lowered: Order of the True Blood [ edit ] Description Lennea says, "When we learned that the library of Leth Nurae had been robbed, we knew to suspect the drake riders ; those who call themselves the Order of the True Blood ." "They are a renegade group of high elves who have turned to drake riding instead of griffon riding." "If the drake riders wanted those ancient tomes, there must be powerful arcane secrets found within them." "Find the books and bring them back before the Order learns what it should not!" [ edit ] Objectives Go to the lair of the drake riders , and search piles of books for the stolen tomes. Bring the books back to Lennea Arrianth at the Wardship of the Sleeping Moon . Stolen Ancient Tome (6) [ edit ] Upon Completion You will be given the following rewards: 600 Celestine Ward faction A coin reward of 3s 50c A choice among: Eargem of Strength , Eargem of Resistance , Sheilding Eargem , Insightful Eargem Potion of Greater Strength , Potion of Greater Constitution , Potion of Greater Dexterity Retrieved from " http://wiki.silkyvenom.com/index.php/Recover_our_History " Category : Thestra 26-30 Quests

faction lowered: None [ edit ] Description Elrena says, "While Zoth Uluus is no longer here, his spoilage remains to corrupt all life." "The unfathomable wall of sea that bore Zoth Uluus at its crest broke here upon the treetops. His darkness seeped into the forest soil and was soaked up by the verdant growth of the forest, giving it a twisted semblance of life." "These living vines creep and destroy what little left that is good. They must be cut back. Bring me their splintered twigs, and I will know of the right you have done." [ edit ] Objectives Travel northeast and slay any spoilcrawlers to be found. Gather their splintered twigs, and bring them to Elrena Faermil at the Recondite Threshold . Splintered Twig (40) [ edit ] Upon Completion You will be given the following rewards: ? faction lowered: Rotblood Troglodytes [ edit ] Description Mansel says, "The ruins of Vol Tuniel have begun to reveal their mysteries, but we do not yet have enough information to solve their puzzle." "You will find many books and bookshelves within the temple. We've studied some of them, but others have proven difficult to reach. I'll give you directions to the books we need." "Return with your notes, and we will sort through them." [ edit ] Objectives In the ruins of the temple of Vol Tuniel, take notes from each of the books Mansel Nott noted. faction lowered: unknown [ edit ] Description Olkurk says, "It is said that if the ten pages of the book of Morfare can be found and brought back together, the book will reveal its power to whoever should read it." "Sadly, the book was torn to pieces and the pages scattered when the Morfare council decided to end their partnership. If you could find the pages, I could bind them back together and reveal the book's magic. If by a stroke of luck you ever find all ten pages, please bring them to me." [ edit ] Objectives Find the ten pages of the book of Morfare scattered across the world of Telon , and return them to Olkurk in Khal . Book of Morfare, Page 1 (0/1) Book of Morfare, Page 2 (0/1) Book of Morfare, Page 3 (0/1) Book of Morfare, Page 4 (0/1) Book of Morfare, Page 5 (0/1) Book of Morfare, Page 6 (0/1) Book of Morfare, Page 7 (0/1) Book of Morfare, Page 8 (0/1) Book of Morfare, Page 9 (0/1) Book of Morfare, Page 10 (0/1) [ edit ] Detailed Information (Spoilers) Obtaining the pages is a lesson in paitence and travel. You will have to goto every continent to find the pages. Plan to spend at least an hour per page and up to two or three on some. On to the pages: Book of Morfare, Page 1 - Qalia ( Khal )- Watcher of the Fates This is the easiest mob involved and the fastest drop I had. The Watcher of the Fates are directly SW of Khal and you can easily find where they are due to the large beacon light that soars into the sky in their area. They are isolated to a hill, but the page drops fast and they have around a ~10% to drop (I actually did a quest there for fun and had 5 pages drop on 10 mobs). Watcher of the Fates are level 10 2 dot skeletons, you should be done here within 20 minutes unless you are unlucky Book of Morfare, Page 2 - Qalia ( Qa Riverbank ) - Turpin This is the probably the longest and hardest part you will encounter. Turpin is a level 25 5 dot Cyclops . Turpin hits medium armor for around 700 per hit and you may find him utterly impossible to solo. It took lots of tricks for me as a disciple to do it at 30. Turpin hits hard, can stun for 4 seconds, and has a minute long duration breath attack that he uses often enough for it to remain on you for the entire fight. Kiting is very difficult due to a small area and traps on the ground. Good news is there's about a 33% chance for the page to drop and a couple named creatures down below. To find Turpin start out at the Neamsong Bunker in Qa Riverbank , run up NW along the cliff past the lion pride, the rat harvesters, and then past Yuni's Step and there should be a giant bone structure, that marks the entrance to Turpin's Pass . Book of Morfare, Page 3 - Qalia ( Skawlra Rock ) - Carnivorous Shell The Carnivorous Shells are level 22-23 4 dots that are clustered in the middle of the island of Skawlra. This makes it hard for low level people to get to them easily without invis, but anyone over 28 should have no difficulty getting to them. It's a 7% drop, so expect to spend an hour trying to get it to drop unless lucky. To get to the area they are in, you have to take one of the tunnels ( Atoll Tunnel under the suspended bridge / large ocean tunnel southside of island). The shells are hard to find at first, but look in the little nooks and cranny beaches. Book of Morfare, Page 4 - Kojan ( Sundering Wasteland ) - Gulgethor Sentinel In Fort Gulgethor which is a level 15-22 dungeon. You should be able to find plenty of them spread out around the side of the crater, but be wary this place can turn into a death trap. The layout is buggy, things like ports can lead to instant death, and the general spawn rate is high. Unknown drop rate, but shouldnt' be too much of a problem. I'd imagine anywhere from 3-7%. Lots of named, quests, and faction opportunities here. Be advised as of Major Update #1 this area is entirely bugged, with no valid loot dropping. Book of Morfare, Page 5 - Kojan ( Jalen's Crossing ) - Occulous of Flame If you've never been to this area it's often called the Taint of the Yukona or the Skyshrine , and is accessed from a device at the center of Jalen's Crossing . It's basically a series of small islands in the sky and is quite annoying. The mobs here are 3 dot level 8-9 Eyes & Imps and you should have little trouble handling them. The big issue here is the sheer number is low and you're working with a whopping 3% drop rate. Thanks to Whitingleaf for confirming you don't need the four orbs. The mobs spawn around the fire island entrance. Just kill every single mob, until it drops. Book of Morfare, Page 6 - Kojan ( Magi Hold ) - Imperial Ice Warden Level 13-15 3 dots giant human types. This is a very annoying area to the West of Tanvu . There are tons of mobs here that train and run. This is not a friendly area and the place they are located in makes it very easy for them to run out of your range. Be prepared for a frustrating 1-2 hours killing them for their 3% drop. To find them, you need to head into Magi Hold , down the ramp, and find the Ice Wing door. Continue down and you should see a giant ice spirit and around that ring are tons of Wardens. Be aware that when they start to run, 50% of the time they drop down to the level below. This means you have to run the whole way around, then down the steps, then around the circle back to your mob. Be warned it's annoying. Book of Morfare, Page 7 - Thestra ( Three Rivers Village ) - Zihurr Soldier First off, this area is in Three Rivers Village near the lake on the map. It's often called Star Lake and is basically a crazy glowing lake (North side of it) with a big special fx meteor in the lake. There are two types of ants here and both have crystals coming out of their bodies. The ones you want are the Soliders (red aggro), you can ignore the Harvesters (yellow non-aggro). Expect to spend an hour here or two if you aren't lucky. 3% chance to drop level 10-12 2 dots. The yellow and red ants are on different spawns so you can focus on killing just the reds. Book of Morfare, Page 8 - Thestra ( Trengal Keep ) - Mutated Trengal Spider Located inside of Trengal Keep you enter via the front entrance and take your first major right. Inside there you should find a ton of spiders, named, and general level 26-33 3 or 4 dot action. The spiders die very easy and unlike almost every other location you visit, you won't be alone here. You should be able to get a page rather quickly from groups in the area. You can also come here with a group for decent loot and lots of quests. The spiders you want are rather large widow type spiders inside the keep. There are plenty of spiders and they are hunted as part of a quest, so live it up. Take your first right at the main entrance for happy spider fun times. Book of Morfare, Page 9 - Thestra ( Misthaven Crossing ) - Vineyard Wasp More specifically these wasps are in the Hillsbury Manor Vineyard . To get to it what you do is enter the manor immediately take a right and wallah you're there. You can hop the wall or walk around. If you're level is high enough you can waltz around without aggro. The problem with the area is it's tightly packed together mobs love to chain and aggro. The other issue is that there are two types of Wasps here and only the Vineyard Wasps drop it. Avoid the undead and drop all kinds of wasps (they are level 21-22 3 dots) until you get your 3% chance at a page. Expect to spend 1-2 hours here depending on your level and luck if solo. Don't try to just kill the one type of wasp as they are all PH'ers for each other. Book of Morfare, Page 10 - Thestra ( Ruins of Vol Tuniel ) - Corrupted Spirit Level 31-32 3 dot wisps in a highly group oriented area. On the plus side, they are the top level, and almost any group that doesn't invis in will kill them. It's good Wardship of the Sleeping Moon faction grinding in the area, but this is the only page you will probably not be doing solo. It should be easy to purchase this page off groups in the area as many people spend levels 28-40 in this area. On the plus side the drop is 7% so it'll come fast on the down side, expect to have some idiot need roll it and then say "hey what is this for?" faction lowered: Rotblood Troglodytes [ edit ] Description Mansel says, "It seems strange that the ceremony to reawaken Vol Tuniel could have gone so wrong. High elves are careful and scientific, even in their religious ceremonies." "The elves here at the Threshold suspect that those who performed the ceremony must have suffered an attack - perhaps another god acted to prevent Vol Tuniel from rising." "You must take notes from more books deep in the east side of the temple. Also, collect remnant ashes from urns, and I will examine them for magical residue." [ edit ] Objectives Search deep in the east side of the temple of Vol Tuniel for urns with ashes remaining in them. Also take notes from two specific books: the Ceremonial Tome and the Monograph of Divination . Return to Mansel Nott at the Recondite Threshold . Take Notes from the Monograph of Divination Take Notes from the Ceremonial Tome Remnant Ashes (5) [ edit ] Upon Completion You will be given the following rewards: ? Celestine Ward faction A coin reward of 6s 50c A choice from: Bow of Vol Anari Shielding Dagger of Vol Anari Fistbinds of Vol Anari Ceremonial Dagger of Vol Anari Retrieved from " http://wiki.silkyvenom.com/index.php/The_Rewakening_of_Vol_Tuniel " Category : Thestra 31-35 Quests

faction lowered: None [ edit ] Description Kailina asks, "Do you enjoy hunting big game, adventurer?" "You may be surprised to find that swale trolls traverse these lands, and they make fine quarry. The beasts can be hard to find, but they're just the right sort of challenge for a go-it-alone hunter." "Fortunately for us, the queen is paying bounties for troll kills. Keep track of your kills with knuckles, and I'll pay out the bounty." "Be careful on your hunt, though... trolls often wander near other dangers." [ edit ] Objectives Kill swale trolls in the Marsh of Peril . Return to Kailina at the Recondite Threshold .
